staticFovContractPort.evidence: Source comparison of offline CameraPose/CameraPath, camera.cjs, NativeCameraTarget and native camera control/observer; no new runtime execution
staticFovContractPort.nativeObserverFovBounds: finite value strictly between zero and float32 PI; matrix/ownership checks remain separate
staticFovContractPort.scopedWrite: target_bytes converts degrees to radians in copied bytes 32..36, native component+0x50; orientation/position, aspect, near/far and restoration contracts unchanged

staticUnwrappedCameraCurvePort.evidence: Source comparison with shared Java CameraPath.unwrapYaw/at, Rust CameraCurve and offline/camera.cjs; no project/game execution
staticUnwrappedCameraCurvePort.previousInteriorSampleFailure: valid repeated turns could accumulate Java unwrapped yaw past the input-key limit, causing Rust/JS Catmull-Rom interior samples to reject while endpoint samples continued
staticUnwrappedCameraCurvePort.evaluation: retain finite unwrapped yaw through Java float-track preparation and the Catmull-Rom polynomial; do not apply the saved-key angle bound to evaluated samples
staticUnwrappedCameraCurvePort.rustValidation: CameraPose.validate retains input yaw bound; validate_evaluated checks finite values, world bounds, pitch and FOV; CameraCurve Java segments use validate_evaluated
staticUnwrappedCameraCurvePort.helperValidation: public pose retains input yaw bound; private checkedPose allows unwrapped yaw only for evaluated samples/wire conversion
staticUnwrappedCameraCurvePort.wireConversion: validate raw geometry before quantization, normalize equivalent yaw before float32 conversion, retain +180 to -180 rule

updatePlayerFromCamera.note: Live updater target matches the primary player; its scoped camera component matches registry membership. Free-camera control remains unimplemented.
